body:
**Summary** This PR adds support for panel customization, through templates in JS and a component prop in React. Props are: - `elements`: an key-based object to retrieve the rendered output of `recent` searches, `suggestions`, and indices (similar to [what Autocomplete provides](https://www.algolia.com/doc/ui-libraries/autocomplete/api-reference/autocomplete-js/autocomplete#param-render)) - `indices`: the object returned by the autocomplete connector (doesn't include recent searches) ### InstantSearch.js ```js autocomplete({ // ... templates: { panel: ({ elements, indices }, { html }) => html`
${elements.recent} ${elements.suggestions}
${elements.instant_search_movies}
`, }, }), ``` ### React InstantSearch ```jsx ( <>
{elements.recent} {elements.suggestions}
{elements.instant_search_movies}
)} /> ``` FX-3563
title: feat(autocomplete): support panel customization
